name: Specific Antibody Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Consensus Diagnostic Criteria for Specific Antibody Deficiency

criteria.description: Normal serum levels of total immunoglobulins (IgG, IgA, IgM)
Impaired antibody response to polysaccharide vaccines (e.g., pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine)
History of recurrent sinopulmonary infections despite normal immunoglobulin levels
Exclusion of other causes of immunodeficiency or secondary antibody deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of recurrent infections with normal total immunoglobulin levels and documented poor antibody response to polysaccharide antigens, after excluding secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires functional antibody testing following polysaccharide vaccination

pathognomonic.notes: Especially infections caused by encapsulated bacteria

pathognomonic.symptomName: Poor antibody response to polysaccharide vaccines
pathognomonic.notes: Demonstrated by inadequate serologic response after vaccination
searchTerms: poor vaccine response to polysaccharide types
weak antibody production after certain vaccines

common.notes: Recurrent or chronic inflammation of the sinuses
Generalized tiredness related to chronic infections

occasional.notes: Persistent cough due to recurrent infections

rare.notes: Severe systemic infection is uncommon but possible
Occasional eczema or other allergic symptoms

laboratory: Normal serum IgG, IgA, and IgM levels
Poor specific antibody response to polysaccharide antigens after vaccination
imaging: Chest X-ray may show bronchiectasis or chronic lung changes in advanced cases
Sinus imaging may reveal chronic sinusitis
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; diagnosis is functional
other: History of recurrent infections despite normal immunoglobulin levels

distinguishingFeatures: Broader antibody deficiency including protein antigens
Deficiency of one or more IgG subclasses

redFlags: Severe or unusual infections (e.g., sepsis, meningitis)
Failure to respond to polysaccharide vaccines
Development of bronchiectasis or chronic lung disease
references: Orange JS, et al. Use and interpretation of diagnostic vaccination in primary immunodeficiency: a working group report of the Basic and Clinical Immunology Interest Section of the American Academy of Allergy, Asthma & Immunology. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2012.
Bonilla FA, et al. Practice parameter for the diagnosis and management of primary immunodeficiency. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2015.
Chapel H, et al. Primary antibody deficiencies. Nat Rev Dis Primers. 2019.
